description: Portable hostile, crash, concurrency, supersession, and evidence vectors for EMILIA Gate Qualification v2.
limitations: Qualification faults describe verifier outputs at the storage-independent qualification boundary; implementations may use different artifact encodings but must preserve the expected fail-closed disposition.
The reference Admission Store is linearizable in one process and non-durable; the vectors specify externally observable transaction boundaries that durable implementations must preserve.
Provider reconciliation is evidence-only. These vectors do not grant provider credentials or authorize network effects.

vectors.description: An exact, current, accepted qualification reaches the protected adapter once.
Shadow mode compares qualification decisions without a store, reservation, protected adapter, credential, or provider effect.
Changing code after qualification refuses the candidate.
Changing a dependency digest refuses the candidate.
Changing a prompt template digest refuses the candidate.
Changing a tool definition digest refuses the candidate.
Changing effective tool permissions refuses the candidate.
Changing model identity refuses the candidate.
Changing the model artifact digest refuses the candidate.
A mutable model alias is indeterminate rather than an exact identity.
Changing retrieval configuration refuses the candidate.
Changing the dynamic retrieval root refuses the candidate.
Changing memory state refuses the candidate.
Changing relevant user input refuses the candidate.
Changing the builder or orchestrator refuses the candidate.
Replacing the candidate manifest after measurement refuses invocation.
A qualification cannot travel into a different assignment.
A missing FAIL terminal outcome makes the campaign graph incomplete.
A missing ABORTED terminal outcome makes the campaign graph incomplete.
A missing EXPIRED terminal outcome makes the campaign graph incomplete.
A discarded issued attempt remains a terminal campaign fact.
Attempts beyond the precommitted ceiling are challenge grinding.
Changing scenario selection for a selective rerun breaks campaign precommitment.
A stale qualification status is indeterminate and cannot reserve.
A revoked qualification cannot reserve.
Equivocated status heads are indeterminate and cannot reserve.
A prompt change at beginInvocation refuses before provider entry.
A model change at beginInvocation refuses before provider entry.
A tool or permission binding change at beginInvocation refuses before provider entry.
A canonical protected-request substitution refuses before provider entry.
A provider operation substitution refuses before provider entry.
A provider-account substitution refuses before provider entry.
A tenant substitution refuses before provider entry.
An operation-id substitution refuses before provider entry.
An exact-action CAID substitution refuses before provider entry.
An action digest substitution refuses before provider entry.
The atomic begin transaction rechecks qualification status currentness and releases authority before provider entry on mismatch.
Input and reservation order cannot change the snapshot digest.
Duplicate AdmissionInput identities are rejected before digesting.
Duplicate resource or reservation identities are rejected before digesting.
Distinct operation identifiers cannot collide after canonicalization.
Changing the authenticated provider audience changes the snapshot digest.
Changing the provider adapter changes the snapshot digest.
Changing the bound provider account changes the snapshot digest.
Changing production to staging changes the snapshot digest.
Changing the admission tenant changes the snapshot digest.
Exactly one hostile concurrent reservation wins for a tenant operation.
Releasing authority does not reopen tenant operation replay.
Exactly one beginInvocation CAS consumes execution authority.
Recovery rotates the invocation capability, rejects the stale token, and accepts authenticated reconciliation with only the rotated token.
A reserved replay unit cannot be double-spent.
A reserved bounded capability cannot be double-spent.
A reserved budget unit cannot be double-spent.
A provider operation identity cannot be reserved twice.
A stale federated lease observation refuses transactional beginInvocation.
A RESERVED admission can be atomically replaced while retaining exact operation identity.
Only a RESERVED predecessor may rotate to a new admission owner while the operation, CAID, action, effect request, provider, adapter, and idempotency key remain exact.
Supersession refuses any operation, CAID, action, request, provider, adapter, or idempotency substitution.
Consumed execution authority cannot be superseded.
Exactly one concurrent successor wins.
Invocation consumption and supersession have one exclusive CAS winner.
A crash after reservation leaves authority RESERVED and provider NOT_ENTERED.
A crash after release leaves no provider attempt and no reusable operation.
A crash after atomic supersession exposes old SUPERSEDED and new RESERVED together.
A crash after beginInvocation commit leaves consumed authority and forbids replay.
Crash recovery moves an open invocation to INDETERMINATE without reopening authority.
Provider commitment evidence alone remains separate from effect truth.
A terminal observed effect remains immutable and consumed after crash.
A crash after beginInvocation but before provider entry requires reconciliation and no retry.
A crash immediately after possible provider entry requires reconciliation and no retry.
A provider timeout after possible commitment is indeterminate and cannot be retried.
Unauthenticated or forged provider evidence cannot establish commitment.
Authenticated evidence bound to another admission is replayed evidence.
Provider COMMITTED and observed-effect DIVERGED are recorded as independent facts without reopening execution authority.
A determinate DIVERGED relation without its required evidence digest is rejected.
A determinate observed-effect relation without its required observed-effect digest is rejected.
A later contradictory provider outcome cannot rewrite authenticated evidence.
A lost acknowledgement after atomic begin is recovered as consumed and reconciled through the evidence-only path without invoking the provider.
Reconciliation uses the evidence-only adapter path and never invokes twice.
